say:3:1260001001:1.text:
Ah...ah... achoo!
Brr, Chippy is freezing! Seems like winter is just around the corner.
say:3:1260001001:1.source_cn: 啊、啊、啊啾——\n呜哇，天越来越冷了，感觉快到冬天了。

say:4:1260001002:1.text: Oh right, November's almost here... time flies so fast, it feels like Sinbad's adventure was just yesterday.
say:4:1260001002:1.source_cn: 对哦，很快就要到十一月了……时间过得好快啊，感觉和辛巴...

say:6:1260001003:1.text: Hey! I heard my name! Long time no see, old friends!
say:6:1260001003:1.source_cn: 嘿！我听到有人在叫我的名字！好久不见，亲爱的朋友们！

say:7:1260001004:1.text: Here, it's a gift for you!

say:8:1260001005:1.text: Wow! Sunflower seeds and nuts! And they come in different flavors!
say:8:1260001005:1.source_cn: 啊！是葵花籽和坚果！而且还有不同口味的！

say:9:1260001006:1.text: And there's an embroidered handkerchief and a little dagger. Thank you, Sinbad!
say:9:1260001006:1.source_cn: 还有刺绣的小手帕和小匕首——谢谢你，辛巴达！

say:10:1260001007:1.text: This embroidery on the handkerchief is exquisite... it looks like the craftsmanship of the royal capital. Sinbad, where did you get this?
say:10:1260001007:1.source_cn: 这手帕的刺绣很精细呢……看着像是王都的手艺。辛巴达，你...

say:11:1260001008:1.text: I managed to snag a few rides on someone else's boat a couple of times. Picked these up while I was out there. Not bad, right?
say:11:1260001008:1.source_cn: 嘿嘿，我抽时间搭别人的船出了几次海。从外面淘换来的。

choice_prompt:12:1260001008.text: I managed to snag a few rides on someone else's boat a couple of times. Picked these up while I was out there. Not bad, right?

say:14:1260001009:0.text: Heh, of course, I could never exclude the greatest mage out there.

say:14:1260001009:0.male: Heh, of course, I could never exclude the greatest mage out there.
say:14:1260001009:0.female: Heh, of course, I could never exclude the greatest mage out there.

say:18:1260001012:0.source_cn: 我拿给懂行的人问过，说这里面的船能航行，只要有魔法的引...

say:19:1260001013:0.text: 据说是能<style="highlight">打开不可思议的棋盘，展开瓶中船的冒险</style>，大概是这种疑似。

say:20:1260001014:1.text: I know nothing about magic, so it's yours—besides, it's clearly made for someone like you!
say:20:1260001014:1.source_cn: 魔法我一窍不通，只能送给你了——我是说，当然和你最配！
say:20:1260001014:1.male: I know nothing about magic, so it's yours—besides, it's clearly made for someone like you!
say:20:1260001014:1.female: I know nothing about magic, so it's yours—besides, it's clearly made for someone like you!

say:21:1260001015:1.text: If you get the chance, take a look and see what's going on with it! And don't forget to tell me what you find out!

say:23:1260001016:1.text: Haha, I'd bet as long as you're on the case, no mystery can remain unsolved.
say:23:1260001016:1.source_cn: 哈，我相信只要你出马，什么难题都不在话下。
say:23:1260001016:1.male: Haha, I'd bet as long as you're on the case, no mystery can remain unsolved.
say:23:1260001016:1.female: Haha, I'd bet as long as you're on the case, no mystery can remain unsolved.

say:25:1260001017:0.text: Hey, check it out, Lucca's coming!

say:30:1260001020:1.text: Don't act so surprised. What brings you here?
say:30:1260001020:1.source_cn: 这话该我问才对，怎么是你。

say:31:1260001021:1.text: Don't get your hopes up, I only brought gifts for <style="stress"><player_name></style> and his friends.
say:31:1260001021:1.source_cn: 别期待啊，这次的礼物只有<style=stress><...
say:31:1260001021:1.male: Don't get your hopes up, I only brought gifts for <style="stress"><player_name></style> and his friends.
say:31:1260001021:1.female: Don't get your hopes up, I only brought gifts for <style="stress"><player_name></style> and her friends.

say:32:1260001022:1.text: Who's talking to you? Simmer down and don't cause any trouble in the city.
say:32:1260001022:1.source_cn: 谁找你。你老实待着，别在城里添乱。

choice_prompt:33:1260001022.text: Who's talking to you? Simmer down and don't cause any trouble in the city.
choice_prompt:33:1260001022.source_cn: 谁找你。你老实待着，别在城里添乱。

say:34:1260001023:1.text: Yes, there's been trouble in the port lately, and we need your insight.
say:34:1260001023:1.source_cn: 嗯，最近港口不太平，我们需要你的智慧。
say:34:1260001023:1.male: Yes, there's been trouble in the port lately, and we need your insight.
say:34:1260001023:1.female: Yes, there's been trouble in the port lately, and we need your insight.

say:37:1260001024:0.text: As if in response to Lucca's words, a roar echoes from nearby.
say:37:1260001024:0.source_cn: 仿佛回应卢卡的提问似的，一阵怒吼从不远处响了起来。

say:38:1260001025:1.text: Two groups of young men, one from the Water Wights, the other from the Carmine Whispers, are in a heated argument!
say:38:1260001025:1.source_cn: 那是两拨年轻小伙子，一边是水鬼帮，一边是血薇帮，双方正...

say:42:1260001026:0.text: Did you do that on purpose?! You almost dislocated my shoulder!
say:42:1260001026:0.source_cn: 哈？你是故意的吧？我肩膀都快被你撞断了！

say:43:1260001027:1.text: You bet I ran into you, filthy Water Wights!
say:43:1260001027:1.source_cn: 撞的就是你们，水鬼帮的臭鱼！

say:44:1260001028:1.text: You posy parrots trying to throw your weight around again? We may have lost, but we're not weak!
say:44:1260001028:1.source_cn: 粉毛鹦鹉，你们又要欺负人？！我们虽然输了，可不是好惹的！

say:47:1260001029:1.text: Looks like they're at it again...

choice:33:0:1.text: Are you here to see me?
choice:33:0:1.male: Are you here to see me?
choice:33:0:1.female: Are you here to see me?

choice:22:0:1.text: I'll take some time to study it.
choice:22:0:1.male: I'll take some time to study it.
choice:22:0:1.female: I'll take some time to study it.

choice:17:0:1.text: Is this... a ship in a bottle?
choice:17:0:1.male: Is this... a ship in a bottle?
choice:17:0:1.female: Is this... a ship in a bottle?

choice:17:1:2.text: It has a unique magical aura...
choice:17:1:2.male: It has a unique magical aura...
choice:17:1:2.female: It has a unique magical aura...

choice:12:1:2.source_cn: 你是不是还忘了一个人？

say:4:1260002001:1.text: Even as they're pulled apart, both gangs continue glaring and hurling insults at each other...
say:4:1260002001:1.source_cn: 即使被拉开，血薇帮与水鬼帮的帮派成员还在彼此怒目而视，...

say:5:1260002002:1.text: Let go of me, I'm going to show these posy parrots what's what!
say:5:1260002002:1.source_cn: 别拦着我，我要给这帮粉毛鹦鹉一点颜色看看！

say:6:1260002003:1.text: Enough, the Carmine Whispers boss is here, show them some respect.
say:6:1260002003:1.source_cn: 行了，人家血薇帮的老大都来了，给他们点面子吧——

say:7:1260002004:1.text: What?! Do I look like I need your respect?!
say:7:1260002004:1.source_cn: 什么？！老子用得到你们给面子？！

say:8:1260002005:1.text: As the conflict seems poised to intensify, a strong voice breaks through the crowd.
say:8:1260002005:1.source_cn: 眼看着争执又有升级的势头，一个有力的声音响了起来。

say:12:1260002007:1.text: ...Boss! Why trouble yourself in person for something so trivial...
say:12:1260002007:1.source_cn: ……当、当家的！这么点小事，您怎么亲自来了……

say:13:1260002008:1.text: Hmph, you lot can't even stand on your own without backup. The Carmine Whispers are full of spineless cowards.
say:13:1260002008:1.source_cn: 哼，没人撑腰连站都站不直的蠢货，血薇帮的人就是孬种。

say:15:1260002010:1.text: Shut it, now! Stand at attention!

say:16:1260002011:1.text: You again. Finished your patrol? How many times is it this week that you've kicked up trouble on the streets?
say:16:1260002011:1.source_cn: 又是你们。巡查完成了吗，这是本周第几次当街闹事了？

say:17:1260002012:1.text: No, boss! It was the Water Wights being unreasonable this time, I—
say:17:1260002012:1.source_cn: 不是，大当家！这次是这帮水鬼帮的人无理取闹——

say:18:1260002013:1.text: Unreasonable? I'm well aware of what's been going on.
say:18:1260002013:1.source_cn: 无理取闹？我知道前因后果。

say:19:1260002014:1.text: Darlo, I don't want to hear anymore. Apologize. We're not going to become a spectacle for outsiders.
say:19:1260002014:1.source_cn: 达里洛，不管是不是故意的，道歉。我们血薇帮有自己的规则...

say:22:1260002017:1.text: Shopa, this time the Water Wights were in the right. With that said, I'll let your words slide just this once.
say:22:1260002017:1.source_cn: 舒帕，这次水鬼帮占理，我不追究你那些发言。

say:23:1260002018:1.text: But remember to mind yourselves. I allow the Water Wights who haven't sided with the Dead Tide Fleet to make a living in the city, but that doesn't mean my tolerance is limitless.
say:23:1260002018:1.source_cn: 但记住，谨言慎行。我允许没和死潮舰队作恶的水鬼帮在城里...

say:24:1260002019:1.text: Your associate Tesio is now swinging from the gallows, so let that be a lesson to you!
say:24:1260002019:1.source_cn: 和你们勾结过的泰西欧在和绞刑架为伴，你们引以为鉴！

say:26:1260002021:1.text: This is a one-time exception, don't expect it to happen again.

say:27:1260002022:1.text: Anyone who can't mind their tongue will be dragged to the edge of the docks where I will personally strap chains to their feet.
say:27:1260002022:1.source_cn: 谁要是敢再犯，我就把他拖去港口，直接沉到海底下。

say:28:1260002023:1.source_cn: 行了，你们各干各的事去吧。

choice_prompt:30:1260002023.source_cn: 行了，你们各干各的事去吧。

say:31:1260002024:1.text: Don't mock me, the Carmine Whispers and Water Wights have been at each other's throats for years, and such hatred isn't easily quelled.
say:31:1260002024:1.source_cn: 你就别笑话我了，血薇和水鬼对立已久，仇恨无法轻易消弭。
say:31:1260002024:1.male: Don't mock me, the Carmine Whispers and Water Wights have been at each other's throats for years, and such hatred isn't easily quelled.
say:31:1260002024:1.female: Don't mock me, the Carmine Whispers and Water Wights have been at each other's throats for years, and such hatred isn't easily quelled.

say:32:1260002025:1.text: Just a bit of friction and suddenly old grudges reignite.
say:32:1260002025:1.source_cn: 稍微有点摩擦，就开始算上新仇旧恨，随时可能爆发更大的矛盾。
say:32:1260002025:1.male: Just a bit of friction and suddenly old grudges reignite.
say:32:1260002025:1.female: Just a bit of friction and suddenly old grudges reignite.

say:35:1260002026:1.text: Fights are common at the docks, but lately, things have been out of control.
say:35:1260002026:1.source_cn: 是。码头上哪有不打架的，但最近事态有点控制不住。

say:36:1260002027:1.text: The Wights have always been two-faced, and with the pressure Sonja and I have been putting on our guys, the Carmine Whispers are also becoming resentful.
say:36:1260002027:1.source_cn: 水鬼帮本来就阳奉阴违，血薇帮的人在索尼娅和我的强压下，...

say:37:1260002028:1.text: So, we've come to you for advice.
say:37:1260002028:1.source_cn: 所以，我们来找你出主意。
say:37:1260002028:1.male: So, we've come to you for advice.
say:37:1260002028:1.female: So, we've come to you for advice.

say:39:1260002029:1.text: If you ask me, just let them fight it out. As long as no one gets killed, they'll eventually tucker themselves out.
say:39:1260002029:1.source_cn: 要我说，你就干脆让他们打去。只要不闹出人命来，打着打着...

say:41:1260002031:1.text: I've been here the whole time! I was here before Lucca even showed up!
say:41:1260002031:1.source_cn: 我一直都在！从卢卡找过来时就在了！

say:42:1260002032:1.text: Never mind, I'm a broad-minded adventurer... I won't hold it against you.
say:42:1260002032:1.source_cn: 算了，我是心胸宽广的冒险家……不计较。

say:43:1260002033:1.text: I saw everything that just went down. Let me give you some advice without holding a grudge. After all, if things get out of hand, it's the people in the city that will suffer.
say:43:1260002033:1.source_cn: 刚才的事我全程都看见了，不记前嫌地给你们出个主意吧。毕...

say:44:1260002034:1.text: And what kind of grand advice could you offer?

say:46:1260002036:1.text: *Cough*—Well, here's what I'll say. On my last voyage, the ship had sailors aboard from all over, and sometimes fights would break out.
say:46:1260002036:1.source_cn: 咳咳——那我就说了。我这次出海，船上都是天南海北来的各...

say:47:1260002037:1.text: Later, I organized a few little shindigs. We all drank, chatted, and passed the time. Once everyone warmed up, the atmosphere completely changed.
say:47:1260002037:1.source_cn: 后来我组织了几次酒会，大家一起喝酒聊天，又玩又闹，等到...

say:48:1260002038:1.text: Since you're not busy and have the means, why not organize something to bring everyone together and create some buzz?
say:48:1260002038:1.source_cn: 你们现在也没什么要紧事，手头也宽裕，趁机组织个什么活动...

say:49:1260002039:1.text: Even if you can't clear up old grudges, at least it'll help them blow off some steam and maybe put a lull in the constant brawls.
say:49:1260002039:1.source_cn: 就算没法冰释前嫌，好歹能发泄点多余的精力，省得一天到晚打架。

say:50:1260002040:1.text: ...Well look at you, kid, after just a few weeks at sea, you've gotten all sophisticated.
say:50:1260002040:1.source_cn: ……你小子，出了几天船，居然开始有模有样了。

say:51:1260002041:1.text: Setting aside how trustworthy the person making the suggestion is, it's certainly a way to go. But...
say:51:1260002041:1.source_cn: 不考虑提出意见的家伙的可靠程度，是个办法。但……

say:52:1260002042:1.text: But...? I'm not hearing any better ideas.
say:52:1260002042:1.source_cn: 但什么？你们还能有更好的方法？

say:55:1260002045:1.text: To bring both sides together without causing further conflict.
say:55:1260002045:1.source_cn: 在不引发矛盾的前提下，把双方凑到一起聚会的理由。

say:56:1260002046:1.text: I can order the Carmine Whispers to attend, but the Water Wights won't be easily convinced.
say:56:1260002046:1.source_cn: 我可以命令血薇帮出席，但水鬼帮不会听话。

say:57:1260002047:1.text: Just then, a rough and familiar voice breaks through.
say:57:1260002047:1.source_cn: 这时，一个熟悉的粗犷嗓音响了起来。

say:60:1260002048:1.text: A reason? The Fall Harvest is just around the corner, what better reason there be?
say:60:1260002048:1.source_cn: 理由？马上就是秋夜节了，还有比这个更好的理由？

say:61:1260002049:1.text: Hahaha, we can restore old customs and have a great time. Isn't that a win-win?
say:61:1260002049:1.source_cn: 嚯哈哈哈，难得的大节日，又能恢复传统，又能联欢，不是一...

say:62:1260002050:0.text: Now that I think of it, I've been here in Rustport for years and I've never seen you organize anything for the <style="highlight">Fall Harvest</style>! You've been too focused on petty disputes to remember the old customs.
say:62:1260002050:0.source_cn: 说起来，我来锈锚港这几年，都没见过你们筹办<style...

choice_prompt:63:1260002050.text: Now that I think of it, I've been here in Rustport for years and I've never seen you organize anything for the <style="highlight">Fall Harvest</style>! You've been too focused on petty disputes to remember the old customs.
choice_prompt:63:1260002050.source_cn: 说起来，我来锈锚港这几年，都没见过你们筹办<style=highlight>秋夜节</style>！你们光想着怎么互相争斗，连传统习俗都忘干净了。

say:64:1260002051:1.text: I don't know either. Is it a dwarven festival?
say:64:1260002051:1.source_cn: 我也不知道。那是矮人的节日吗？

say:65:1260002053:1.text: Uh, Fall Harvest? Hmm... I've heard it mentioned. Some sailors got drunk before we set sail and said it was close to the festival, so they might as well celebrate early.
say:65:1260002053:1.source_cn: 呃，秋夜节？嗯……我听人提起过，出航时有水手喝得酩酊大...

say:66:1260002054:1.text: But at the time, I was busy navigating them around the reefs, so I didn't have time to ask for details...
say:66:1260002054:1.source_cn: 不过，那时候我正忙着给他们导航躲避礁石，没来得及细问……

say:67:1260002055:1.text: ...You... You lot! You've never even heard of the Fall Harvest?!
say:67:1260002055:1.source_cn: ……你……你们几个！竟然连秋夜节都没听说过？！

say:72:1260002057:0.source_cn: 没办法嘛呼金，主人失忆了……
say:72:1260002057:0.male: It can't be helped, Hugin, the Magister's lost his memory...
say:72:1260002057:0.female: It can't be helped, Hugin, the Magister's lost her memory...

say:75:1260002058:1.text: Folks, the Fall Harvest is one of the most important holidays.
say:75:1260002058:1.source_cn: 各位，秋夜节是重大的民间节日之一哦。

say:76:1260002059:1.text: Everyone celebrates in their own way on the last day of October.
say:76:1260002059:1.source_cn: 无论是什么种族，在十月的最后一天，都会用自己的方式尽情庆祝。

say:79:1260002060:1.text: ...The last day of October? That's coming up soon!
say:79:1260002060:1.source_cn: ……十月的最后一天？那不是没多久了？

say:82:1260002061:1.text: If we're planning to gather everyone for the Fall Harvest, we need to hurry and set things up...
say:82:1260002061:1.source_cn: 如果要借用秋夜节的机会，那就得尽快筹办……

say:86:1260002063:1.text: Maho? What's going on? Darlo and his crew up to no good again?
say:86:1260002063:1.source_cn: 马奥？怎么，达里洛他们又闹事了？

say:87:1260002064:1.text: N-no, not Darlo... it's a monster—a big, green monster!
say:87:1260002064:1.source_cn: 不、不是达里洛……是，是怪物——绿色的，大怪物！

say:88:1260002065:1.text:
Monster?!
Lucca, follow me, let's go see!
say:88:1260002065:1.source_cn: 怪物？！\n卢卡，跟上，我们去看看！

choice:69:0:1.text: I might have known, but I forgot.
choice:69:0:1.male: I might have known, but I forgot.
choice:69:0:1.female: I might have known, but I forgot.

say:90:1260002052:1.text: The Chainkeeper needs repair materials, so I'm off to squeeze some merchants for better supplies!
say:90:1260002052:1.source_cn: 我？枷锁号维修缺板材和零件，我要去敲打敲打商人，让他们...

say:5:1260003001:0.text: The woman beside that familiar green monster is the same figure seen in the Dark Forest before—
say:5:1260003001:0.source_cn: 那熟悉的绿色怪物身边出现的女性，正是曾在薄暮丛林见到过...

say:8:1260003004:0.text: What are you doing in Rustport?!

say:14:1260003006:1.text: Are you with the Dead Tide Fleet?

say:15:1260003007:1.text: Dead Tide Fleet? How insulting. Don't lump me in with those sea-stinking brutes—even my servant wouldn't lower himself to their level.
say:15:1260003007:1.source_cn: 死潮舰队？真冒犯。别把那群一身海腥味的粗人和我相提并论...

say:16:1260003008:1.text: She actually called that green monster her servant.
say:16:1260003008:1.source_cn: 竟然把那个绿色的藤蔓怪物称为仆人。

say:17:1260003009:1.text: My word, this place is rampant with ignorant fools.
say:17:1260003009:1.source_cn: 真是的，这里怎么到处都是些没有见识的家伙。

say:18:1260003010:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I must admit that your choice had some merit.
say:18:1260003010:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I must admit that your choice had some merit.
say:18:1260003010:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I must admit that your choice had some merit.

say:19:1260003011:1.text: I hate noisy subordinates, which is why I treasure my servant's silence...
say:19:1260003011:1.source_cn: 我讨厌聒噪的部下，而让仆人保持可贵的沉默……
say:19:1260003011:1.male: I hate noisy subordinates, which is why I treasure my servant's silence...
say:19:1260003011:1.female: I hate noisy subordinates, which is why I treasure my servant's silence...

say:20:1260003012:1.text: Consequently, I find myself having to partake in a senseless conversation with creatures who don't even deserve to brush the hem of my gown.
say:20:1260003012:1.source_cn: 这就导致此时此刻，我不得不亲自与一些甚至没有资格碰触我...
say:20:1260003012:1.male: Consequently, I find myself having to partake in a senseless conversation with creatures who don't even deserve to brush the hem of my gown.
say:20:1260003012:1.female: Consequently, I find myself having to partake in a senseless conversation with creatures who don't even deserve to brush the hem of my gown.

say:21:1260003013:1.text: Summoning some talking familiars early on, like you did, would've saved a lot of trouble.
say:21:1260003013:1.source_cn: 如果像你这样早早地召唤一些会说话的使魔，就可以省去不少...
say:21:1260003013:1.male: Summoning some talking familiars early on, like you did, would've saved a lot of trouble.

choice_prompt:22:1260003013.female: Summoning some talking familiars early on, like you did, would've saved a lot of trouble.

say:23:1260003015:1.text: Why have you come to Rustport to wreak havoc?
say:23:1260003015:1.source_cn: 你来锈锚港作乱，有什么目的？

say:24:1260003016:0.text: 是为了找寻霍德希金带走的<style="highlight">班题斯圣器</style>吗？
say:24:1260003016:0.source_cn: 是为了找寻霍德希金带走的<style=highligh...

say:25:1260003017:1.text: If that's what you're here for, you're out of luck. It sank to the deeps with Hodgkin ages ago.
say:25:1260003017:1.source_cn: 如果是为它，你找错了地方。那东西早就和霍德希金一起沉入...

say:26:1260003018:1.text: You're the boss of this place, huh? You seem rather sharp.
say:26:1260003018:1.source_cn: 你就是港口的主人吗？头脑倒是还算聪敏。

say:27:1260003019:1.text: The Void Relic is a sacred object every servant of Death dreams of, and if someone chooses to offer it to me on bended knee, I'd happily accept.
say:27:1260003019:1.source_cn: 圣器是每个死神的子民都梦寐以求的圣物，如果有人愿意屈膝...

say:28:1260003020:1.text: But, scrounging around for something myself... that's far too undignified, even if it's the Void Relic.
say:28:1260003020:1.source_cn: 但，四处寻找东西……这太有失身份了，即使对象是圣器也一样。

say:29:1260003021:1.text: That's why I let my servant arrive first to pay you the courtesy of a proper introduction.
say:29:1260003021:1.source_cn: 所以我让仆人来事先打个招呼，以示礼节。

say:32:1260003022:1.text: ...Enough! Quit beating around the bush and just tell us what your angle is.
say:32:1260003022:1.source_cn: ……听不下去了，你是什么意思？拐弯抹角的，一个“是”或...

say:35:1260003023:1.text: 简单来说，她不是死潮舰队一伙的，也不是为了班题斯圣器而来，让那个绿色怪物闹事也只是随心所欲……
say:35:1260003023:1.source_cn: 简单来说，她不是死潮舰队一伙的，也不是为了班题斯圣器而...

choice_prompt:36:1260003023.text: 简单来说，她不是死潮舰队一伙的，也不是为了班题斯圣器而来，让那个绿色怪物闹事也只是随心所欲……
choice_prompt:36:1260003023.source_cn: 简单来说，她不是死潮舰队一伙的，也不是为了班提斯圣器而来，让那个绿色怪物闹事也只是随心所欲……

say:37:1260003025:1.text: Well then, since <style="stress"><player_name></style> has asked, it wouldn't be proper to continue evading the issue.
say:37:1260003025:1.male: Well then, since <style="stress"><player_name></style> has asked, it wouldn't be proper to continue evading the issue.
say:37:1260003025:1.female: Well then, since <style="stress"><player_name></style> has asked, it wouldn't be proper to continue evading the issue.

say:38:1260003026:1.text: Everyone, consider this my gift for the upcoming Fall Harvest— a blessing from the dead.
say:38:1260003026:1.source_cn: 诸位，就当作我是为即将到来的秋夜节，给予诸位来自亡者的...

say:39:1260003027:1.text: I extend my early wishes for a joyous Fall Harvest to you all.
say:39:1260003027:1.source_cn: 提前祝诸位，秋夜节愉快。

say:43:1260003029:1.text: What does "blessing from the dead" mean? Is that some declaration of attack?
say:43:1260003029:1.source_cn: “亡者的祝福”是什么意思，是敌袭宣言吗？

say:46:1260003030:1.text: No idea. But she didn't seem all that hostile.
say:46:1260003030:1.source_cn: 不知道。看她也不像很有敌意。

say:49:1260003031:1.text: On that note, even that Graveborn is aware of the Fall Harvest...
say:49:1260003031:1.source_cn: 话说回来，连亡灵都知道秋夜节……

say:50:1260003032:1.text: And yet, out of everyone present, only Merlin's familiar and I are aware of this basic knowledge... Whistler is shaking with rage, refusing to support me!
say:50:1260003032:1.source_cn: 结果在场这么一帮人，除了我和梅林的使魔，你们居然都对这...
say:50:1260003032:1.male: And yet, out of everyone present, only Merlin's familiar and I are aware of this basic knowledge... Whistler is shaking with rage, refusing to support me!
say:50:1260003032:1.female: And yet, out of everyone present, only Merlin's familiar and I are aware of this basic knowledge... Whistler is shaking with rage, refusing to support me!

say:53:1260003033:0.text: Ugh, why are you defending her?!

say:54:1260003034:1.text: Unacceptable is unacceptable, no matter who she is!
say:54:1260003034:1.source_cn: 不合理的事，就是不合理！和她是什么身份没关系！

say:57:1260003035:1.text: Enough, all of you. Quit fooling around. We need to increase patrols—there's no way that Graveborn disappeared without a trace.
say:57:1260003035:1.source_cn: 好了，你们几个，别插科打诨了。我们需要加强巡视，那个亡...

say:58:1260003036:1.text: If she sends something else to "greet" us, we need to deal with it quickly. If the citizens learn there's another Graveborn roaming around, it'll be chaos.
say:58:1260003036:1.source_cn: 万一又派了别的东西“打招呼”，还得及时清除。要是被市民...

say:59:1260003037:1.text: Lucca, assign two squads—one to patrol along the coast, the other to guard the city at night.
say:59:1260003037:1.source_cn: 卢卡，你派人分两队，一队沿海岸巡视，一队在城内守夜。

choice:42:1:2.text: She refused to give a clear answer.
choice:42:1:2.male: She refused to give a clear answer.
choice:42:1:2.female: She refused to give a clear answer.

say:62:1260003024:1.text: There's no need to keep prying. That's just basic politeness. Could it be I overestimated your refinement? If so, my apologies.
say:62:1260003024:1.source_cn: 既然知道是刻意，就不应该继续追问了，这才是基础的礼貌。...
say:62:1260003024:1.male: There's no need to keep prying. That's just basic politeness. Could it be I overestimated your refinement? If so, my apologies.
say:62:1260003024:1.female: There's no need to keep prying. That's just basic politeness. Could it be I overestimated your refinement? If so, my apologies.

choice:22:0:1.male: My summoning skills are beyond you.
choice:22:0:1.female: My summoning skills are beyond you.

choice:22:1:2.source_cn: 别说得我们好像很熟一样！

say:63:1260003014:0.text: Hmph, as arrogant as ever. But strength gives one the right to be prideful; to bow would only lack grace.
say:63:1260003014:0.source_cn: 哼，仍旧狂妄无礼。不过强者天生就有傲慢的资本，要是卑躬...
say:63:1260003014:0.male: Hmph, as arrogant as ever. But strength gives one the right to be prideful; to bow would only lack grace.
say:63:1260003014:0.female: Hmph, as arrogant as ever. But strength gives one the right to be prideful; to bow would only lack grace.

choice:22:2:3.source_cn: 顺便，满满漫漫比你的仆人可爱！
choice:22:2:3.male: Chippy and Hammie are far cuter!
choice:22:2:3.female: Chippy and Hammie are far cuter!

say:3:1260004001:1.text: *Yawn* Good morning. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, how did you sleep?
say:3:1260004001:1.male: *Yawn* Good morning. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, how did you sleep?
say:3:1260004001:1.female: *Yawn* Good morning. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, how did you sleep?

say:4:1260004002:1.text: We had a good rest! But Lucca, are you alright? You seem like you haven't slept at all.
say:4:1260004002:1.source_cn: 我们睡得很好！但是你没事吧，卢卡？看起来好像一夜没睡似的。

say:5:1260004003:1.text: Well, I was out patrolling all night long.
say:5:1260004003:1.source_cn: 嗯，四处巡逻，忙了一整夜。

say:8:1260004004:1.text: Sinbad also looks like he's still half-asleep...
say:8:1260004004:1.source_cn: 辛巴达也一副没睡醒的样子……

say:11:1260004005:1.text: *Yawn* Morning, guys. Ready for some action? Even though I'm not a part of the Carmine Whispers, I won't sit this one out since Rustport is my home.
say:11:1260004005:1.source_cn: ……呼啊啊啊，虽然我不是血薇帮的人，但锈锚港算是我的半...

say:12:1260004006:1.text: After all, that "greeting" from the Graveborn yesterday was nuts. If her "servant" keeps appearing in Rustport, it'll disrupt the peace we've worked so hard for.
say:12:1260004006:1.source_cn: 毕竟昨天那个亡灵留下的“问候”太危险了，她的那个……“...

choice_prompt:13:1260004006.text: After all, that "greeting" from the Graveborn yesterday was nuts. If her "servant" keeps appearing in Rustport, it'll disrupt the peace we've worked so hard for.
choice_prompt:13:1260004006.source_cn: 毕竟昨天那个亡灵留下的“问候”太危险了，她的那个……“仆人”，要是继续在锈锚港里出现，好不容易安定下来的人心又要乱起来了。

say:14:1260004007:1.text: The Water Wights and Carmine Whispers were their usual selves, nearly brawling in the tavern, but it was quiet otherwise.
say:14:1260004007:1.source_cn: 水鬼帮和血薇帮的年轻人还是那个样，差点在酒馆打起来，但...

say:15:1260004009:1.text: Is it possible that the Graveborn simply showed up to make a spectacle and then took off? Was it just a show?
say:15:1260004009:1.source_cn: 难道说那个亡灵真的就是打了个招呼然后离开了？只是虚张声势？

say:16:1260004010:1.text: Don't let your guard down yet. With that kind of an entrance, she's got something up her sleeve.
say:16:1260004010:1.source_cn: 先别放心得太早，看她出场那个威风凛凛的架势，必然会有什...

say:17:1260004011:1.text: Maybe she isn't the type who likes schemes and tricks; she might prefer straightforward—
say:17:1260004011:1.source_cn: 或许她不是喜欢阴谋诡计的那一派，更喜欢堂堂正正的——

say:18:1260004012:0.text: A sudden uproar breaks Sinbad's train of thought. Now, a figure rushes toward you.
say:18:1260004012:0.source_cn: 突然，一阵大呼小叫传来，打断了辛巴达的推测。随后一个身...

say:21:1260004013:0.text:
Make way, make way!
It's bad, Lucca! We're in serious trouble!
say:21:1260004013:0.source_cn: 让让，让让！\n不好了，卢卡二当家！大事不好了！

say:24:1260004014:0.text: Huh? It's you again? Were you the one who mentioned seeing the green monster yesterday?
say:24:1260004014:0.source_cn: 咦？又是你？昨天说看到绿色怪物的也是你吧？

say:27:1260004015:0.text: What's wrong, Maho? Calm down. Did your buddies get into another fight?
say:27:1260004015:0.source_cn: 怎么了，马奥，冷静点，兄弟们又跟人打起来了？

say:28:1260004016:1.text: No, that's not it. The Bobcat and the Bear mentioned they were heading to confront the Water Wights this morning, but they've disappeared.
say:28:1260004016:1.source_cn: 不、不是，“山猫”跟“暴熊”今天早上说要去找水鬼帮麻烦...

say:29:1260004017:1.text: Guessing where they'd gone to challenge the Wights, I planned to check their usual spots to see what was going on.
say:29:1260004017:1.source_cn: 我以为是他们又去找水鬼帮约架，就打算上他们常去的地方找...

say:30:1260004018:1.text:
And then, and then—
I saw giant rats scurrying through the streets!
say:30:1260004018:1.source_cn: 结果、结果——\n在街道上，有超级巨大的老鼠在到处乱跑！！

say:31:1260004019:1.text: Giant rats? Could they be related to that Graveborn from yesterday?!
say:31:1260004019:1.source_cn: 巨大老鼠？难道和昨天那个亡灵有关？！

say:36:1260004008:1.text: Everything was fine. Just now, I visited the workers who might have seen that lady and the monster yesterday, and they reported nothing unusual.
say:36:1260004008:1.source_cn: 完全没事。就在刚才，我还特意走访了下昨天有可能目击到那...

say:2:1260005001:1.text: These rats are tough to handle! They seem more ferocious than those in the sewers...
say:2:1260005001:1.source_cn: 这些耗子真不好对付！怎么感觉比在下水道栖息的那些还狂暴……

say:3:1260005002:0.text: Suddenly, the bodies of the giant rats begin to convulse before their fur vanishes and their figures warp—
say:3:1260005002:0.source_cn: 突然，地上横七竖八昏厥的巨鼠肌肉开始猛烈地颤动，随后，...

say:4:1260005003:0.text: In just a few seconds, the terrifying beasts transform into somewhat familiar forms.
say:4:1260005003:0.source_cn: 短短数秒间，方才还令人心悸的可怖恶兽，已经变成了有些熟...

say:6:1260005004:0.text: Jeb? Shopa?! They're with the Water Wights! How is this possible?!
say:6:1260005004:0.source_cn: ——杰博？舒帕？！是水鬼帮的人？！怎么会是他们？！

say:10:1260005007:1.text: Hey, snap out of it! What's going on here?
say:10:1260005007:1.source_cn: 喂，清醒点！你们这是怎么回事？

say:11:1260005008:1.text: Ugh, my head is killing me...

say:12:1260005009:1.text: My mind's all foggy, like I'm drunk, but we didn't drink this morning... did we?
say:12:1260005009:1.source_cn: 脑子昏昏沉沉的，像是喝醉了似的，但今天早上我们没喝酒…...

say:15:1260005010:0.text: Wait, wait, isn't that Lucca from the Carmine Whispers?! When did you arrive? We didn't cause any trouble!
say:15:1260005010:0.source_cn: 喂，喂喂，这不是血薇帮的卢卡吗？！你什么时候来的？我们...

say:18:1260005011:1.text: About making trouble... I think I made a mess. But... I can't recall...
say:18:1260005011:1.source_cn: 说到惹事……我好像大闹了一番。可、可是想不起来……

say:19:1260005012:1.text: Ugh, yuck, I have this strange taste in my mouth—I swear I had a wild dream about biting through metal bars!

choice_prompt:20:1260005012.text: Ugh, yuck, I have this strange taste in my mouth—I swear I had a wild dream about biting through metal bars!
choice_prompt:20:1260005012.source_cn: 呸、呸呸，我嘴里一股奇怪的味道——之前好像还做了个疯狂咬栏杆的怪梦！

say:21:1260005013:1.text: What?! You're telling me I actually chewed through bars?!
say:21:1260005013:1.source_cn: 啥？！你是说，我真的去咬栏杆了？！
say:21:1260005013:1.male: What?! You're telling me I actually chewed through bars?!
say:21:1260005013:1.female: What?! You're telling me I actually chewed through bars?!

say:24:1260005015:1.text: By the way, you're Shopa, right? You sure went all out biting us—no wonder your nickname is the "Fang"!
say:24:1260005015:1.source_cn: 话说，舒帕兄弟是吧？你刚刚对我们下嘴可真够狠的，怪不得...

say:25:1260005016:1.text: Zip it! "Fang" just relates to my vicious attacks! I didn't actually bite anyone!
say:25:1260005016:1.source_cn: 闭嘴！毒牙是我的外号，形容我难以提防的凶狠攻击！谁咬人了！

say:26:1260005017:1.text: No, you've definitely got some chompers on ya, and that big guy next to you was charging all over—I've never seen a rat that muscular before.
say:26:1260005017:1.source_cn: 你可没少咬，还有你旁边这个大个子兄弟，也是左突右冲的，...

say:27:1260005018:1.text: The little guy here is quieter but sneakier, biting stealthily when you're not looking.
say:27:1260005018:1.source_cn: 这位小个子兄弟倒是老实点，就是偷偷摸摸地下嘴，让人防不...

say:30:1260005019:1.text: Time for some answers. How were you turned into rats?
say:30:1260005019:1.source_cn: 所以你们几个，为什么会变成老鼠？

say:31:1260005020:1.text: I...I can't remember! I'm still groggy, it all felt like a dream.
say:31:1260005020:1.source_cn: ——想不起来！我现在还晕晕乎乎的，刚刚就跟做梦一样。

say:32:1260005021:1.text: Belp, you were the last to arrive, do you remember what happened?
say:32:1260005021:1.source_cn: 比尔，你是最晚到的，记得发生了什么吗？

say:35:1260005022:1.text: Let me think... When I found you, you had just finished scrapping with the Carmine Whispers. I remember Jeb even punching the Bobcat.
say:35:1260005022:1.source_cn: 我想想……找到你们的时候，你们刚跟血薇帮的人吵完。记得...

say:36:1260005023:1.text: I was going to walk over, but the Carmine Whispers came toward me, looking furious, so I booked it.
say:36:1260005023:1.source_cn: 正想过去跟你们打招呼，但血薇帮的人气势汹汹地朝着我的方...

say:37:1260005024:1.text: I remember now! I was in a side alley, and I caught a glimpse of a... a...
say:37:1260005024:1.source_cn: 我想起来了！我走到一条小巷里，然后……我瞥到了一个，一个——

say:39:1260005026:1.text: A green monster—that's the Graveborn's servant we saw yesterday!
say:39:1260005026:1.source_cn: 绿色的怪物，那是我们昨天见到的亡灵的仆人！

say:40:1260005027:1.text: I was shocked, but a moment later, it was gone. Figured my eyes were playing tricks on me...
say:40:1260005027:1.source_cn: 我吓了一跳，但下一秒，那里就空无一人了。我还以为是自己...

say:41:1260005028:1.text: But when I turned around, my legs went numb, and my mind blanked...
say:41:1260005028:1.source_cn: 但一转身，脚就没了知觉，然后脑子也一片混沌……

say:42:1260005029:1.text: I have these hazy memories of running wild, but when I came to, I was just as you see me now.
say:42:1260005029:1.source_cn: 隐隐约约地觉得好像干了好多事，但清醒过来就是刚才那样了。

say:45:1260005030:0.text: Oof, my whole body hurts... How did we turn back? Did you use magic on us, or...?
say:45:1260005030:0.source_cn: 哎哟，全身都疼……我们是怎么恢复过来的？你们对我们用了...

say:48:1260005031:1.text: Don't question it, Jeb. You should just be thankful you're back to normal.
say:48:1260005031:1.source_cn: 别打听了，杰博老哥，能变回来就比什么都强。

say:49:1260005032:1.text: This means that Graveborn woman isn't done with us. How could she dare to cast a spell in broad daylight and turn people into rats!
say:49:1260005032:1.source_cn: 各位，这样说来，那个女亡灵果然没打算就这么结束。她竟然...

say:52:1260005033:1.text: It's not just a transformation spell, but a fleshweave spell... much like the sinister arts of Viperian, the Graveborn of the Dead Tide Fleet!
say:52:1260005033:1.source_cn: 那和只变幻外形的幻形法术不同，是货真价实的血肉魔法……...

say:53:1260005034:0.text: But Viperian's magic demands constant control, while Cecia's spell worked quickly, though its effects seem unstable.
say:53:1260005034:0.source_cn: 但是维珀里安的法术需要长期的操作维持，和他相比，瑟西娅...

say:54:1260005035:0.text: That means if we act quickly, we might be able to change everyone back!
say:54:1260005035:0.source_cn: 也就是说，如果我们发现得够早，还有让大家复原的可能性！

choice_prompt:55:1260005035.text: That means if we act quickly, we might be able to change everyone back!
choice_prompt:55:1260005035.source_cn: 也就是说，如果我们发现得够早，还有让大家复原的可能性！

say:56:1260005036:0.text: Now this is fun. We have an excuse to go after those we can't stand! Totally justified too!
say:56:1260005036:0.source_cn: 这倒是有意思。也就是说，可以借着这个机会对平时看不惯的...

say:59:1260005037:1.text: Now's not the time to settle personal scores.

say:60:1260005039:1.text: They might not be the only ones affected. Where will she strike next?
say:60:1260005039:1.source_cn: 受害者可能不止他们几个，下一波会在哪里？

say:61:1260005040:1.text: Just now, Belp said they split after scrapping with the Carmine Whispers, then saw a green monster and turned into rats...
say:61:1260005040:1.source_cn: 刚刚那个比尔老弟说，他们几个跟血薇帮吵完之后分开了，随...

say:62:1260005041:1.text: Lucca, maybe one of your guys knows something.
say:62:1260005041:1.source_cn: 卢卡，你的小弟说不定知道什么。

say:63:1260005042:1.text: Let's go and see what we can find.

say:66:1260005043:0.text: Just as everyone is about to set off, a commotion suddenly erupts. Sonja parts the gasping crowd and walks toward you with a furrowed brow.
say:66:1260005043:0.source_cn: 大家正准备出发时，周围突然又爆发出一阵骚动，只见索尼娅...

say:67:1260005044:0.text: Sonja! Where have you been? We could've used your help.
say:67:1260005044:0.source_cn: 索尼娅！你怎么这时候才来，刚刚才是我们需要你的时候。

say:68:1260005045:0.text: Now it's me who needs you. Follow me immediately to the Sanctum Square, near Dura's Statue.
say:68:1260005045:0.source_cn: 现在是我需要你们，立刻跟我去颂神广场，女神像附近。

say:69:1260005046:1.text: A group of <style="highlight">Graveborn monsters</style> just appeared there!
say:69:1260005046:1.source_cn: 那里刚刚出现了一群<style=highlight>亡...

choice:55:0:1.text: And thrash them til they turn back?
choice:55:0:1.source_cn: 然后就像刚才那样再打一顿……？
choice:55:0:1.male: And thrash them til they turn back?
choice:55:0:1.female: And thrash them til they turn back?

say:73:1260005038:0.text: Summoning monsters yesterday, turning people into rats today—none of it can stand!
say:73:1260005038:0.source_cn: 不管是像昨天那样召唤怪物，还是像今天这样把人变成老鼠，...

choice:55:1:2.text: She's bound to have more tricks.
choice:55:1:2.male: She's bound to have more tricks.
choice:55:1:2.female: She's bound to have more tricks.

say:74:1260005014:1.text: R-rats?! Like the ones from the sewers?! Rats?!
say:74:1260005014:1.source_cn: 耗、耗子？！下水道的那种？！耗子？！
say:74:1260005014:1.male: R-rats?! Like the ones from the sewers?! Rats?!
say:74:1260005014:1.female: R-rats?! Like the ones from the sewers?! Rats?!

say:3:1260006001:0.text: Could these Graveborn monsters also be...?
say:3:1260006001:0.source_cn: 这些亡灵怪物，该不会也……

say:5:1260006003:0.text: As Chippy's gasps fill the air, the monsters' bodies twist and writhe, revealing ordinary women.
say:5:1260006003:0.source_cn: 随着满满的惊呼，怪物的身形开始扭曲，露出了平凡女性的身影。

say:9:1260006004:0.text: They appear disoriented, but after a few moments, they begin to regain their senses...
say:9:1260006004:0.source_cn: 她们看起来昏昏沉沉，过了片刻才终于恢复了些许精神……

say:10:1260006005:0.text: What just happened... Ugh, I feel nauseous...
say:10:1260006005:0.source_cn: 发生了什么事……呜呃，有点想吐……

say:11:1260006006:0.text: My vision's all blurry, and my body aches all over...
say:11:1260006006:0.source_cn: 眼睛好花，身上怎么这么酸痛……

say:12:1260006007:0.text: I just had what felt like an exhausting dream...
say:12:1260006007:0.source_cn: 刚刚好像是做了个很累人的梦……

say:13:1260006008:1.text: Miss Sonja? What are you doing here?!
say:13:1260006008:1.source_cn: 咦，索尼娅女士？您怎么在这里？！

say:16:1260006009:0.text: If I'm not mistaken, you're the sail makers who work at the docks, right?
say:16:1260006009:0.source_cn: ……你们……我没记错的话，你们是在码头附近专门负责船帆...

say:17:1260006010:0.text: Two weeks ago, when several ships were waiting to set sail, I remember meeting you and asking about the emergency orders.
say:17:1260006010:0.source_cn: 前两周好几艘船都等着出海，我记得那时我们见过面，问过你...

say:18:1260006011:0.text: Yes, I was the foreman in charge, and the one who negotiated with you. These two were there as well, helping to evaluate deadlines and quality.
say:18:1260006011:0.source_cn: 对，我是负责的工长，那时是我和您谈判的，她俩当时也在，...

say:21:1260006012:1.text: It seems these people are innocent victims too.
say:21:1260006012:1.source_cn: 看起来这几个人也是无辜的受害者。

say:22:1260006013:0.text: Victims... too? Did you all experience something similar just now?
say:22:1260006013:0.source_cn: 受害者……也？你们刚刚碰到了一样的情况？

say:25:1260006014:1.text: In a way. Earlier, some of those troublemakers from the Water Wights were turned into rats.
say:25:1260006014:1.source_cn: 类似。之前那几个爱挑事的水鬼帮，他们被变成了老鼠。

say:28:1260006017:1.text: First they turn into rats, then into Graveborns... things are getting more and more complicated.
say:28:1260006017:1.source_cn: 一会儿变成老鼠，一会儿变成亡灵……事情真是越来越复杂了。

say:29:1260006018:1.text: Everyone, I'm going to get this sorted out. Before you passed out, did anything out of the ordinary happen?
say:29:1260006018:1.source_cn: 各位，刚刚的情况我会安排人去调查清楚，你们在失去意识之...

say:32:1260006019:0.text: The three of us agreed to work overtime today. I got to the factory first, but I didn't notice anything unusual.
say:32:1260006019:0.source_cn: 我们三个约好今天去赶工加班，我先到了工厂，但没发现有什...

say:35:1260006020:1.text: I-I think I saw something strange!
say:35:1260006020:1.source_cn: 我、我好像看到了一些不寻常的东西！

say:36:1260006021:0.text: I was taking my daughter to meet her friend and got delayed, so when I picked up Achillea, we were already running late.
say:36:1260006021:0.source_cn: 我送女儿去找朋友玩，路上耽搁了一些，所以叫上阿奇雅一起...

say:37:1260006022:1.text: Before we met Shalin, we lifted our skirts and took a watery shortcut...
say:37:1260006022:1.source_cn: 见到施琳之前，我们提着裙子，抄了一条近路……

say:40:1260006023:0.text: Hmph, this time, you'll be the highlight of the Fall Harvest.
say:40:1260006023:0.source_cn: ……呵，这次就选你们成为秋夜节的余兴吧 。

say:41:1260006024:0.text: Achillea, did you spot the woman in front of us?
say:41:1260006024:0.source_cn: 阿奇雅，你看到前面那个女人了吗？

say:43:1260006025:2.text: What's wrong, Zolla? There's no one there.
say:43:1260006025:2.source_cn: 怎么了，卓菈。那边什么人都没有呀。

say:44:1260006026:0.text: What... she vanished? Was I mistaken?
say:44:1260006026:0.source_cn: 咦……消失了？是我看错了吗？

say:47:1260006028:0.text: Next thing I knew, the world was spinning, and then I blacked out.
say:47:1260006028:0.source_cn: 紧接着，我突然感到一阵天旋地转，然后就什么都不知道了。

say:48:1260006029:0.text: She stayed in the shadows, so I couldn't see her face clearly. Oddly enough, even without a clear view, I felt she must be beautiful.
say:48:1260006029:0.source_cn: 那个人一直在暗处，我没看清她的相貌。不知为何，尽管没看...

say:51:1260006030:1.text: Understood. Please don't leave. I'll send for a physician to examine you.
say:51:1260006030:1.source_cn: 我知道了。你们先不要离开，我派人请医师来给你们检查身体。

say:53:1260006031:1.text: Sounds like the same Graveborn from yesterday. You called her Cecia, yes?
say:53:1260006031:1.source_cn: 这听起来就是昨天那个亡灵做的没错。你们管她叫什么，瑟西娅？

say:56:1260006032:1.text: We met her in the Dark Forest. She was draining the life force of the Lucent Tree.
say:56:1260006032:1.source_cn: 我们在薄暮丛林见过她，那个时候，她正在抽取丛林里的生命力。

say:60:1260006034:0.text: But she was courteous to us. It felt like she had a true motive outside of pure evil.
say:60:1260006034:0.source_cn: 不过她对我们还算客气。比起单纯作恶，她更像是为了达成什...

say:61:1260006035:1.text: Hmph, a motive... what kind of noble goal would a Graveborn possibly have?
say:61:1260006035:1.source_cn: 哼，目的……亡灵还能有什么目的？

say:62:1260006036:1.text: To casually turn random people into Graveborn like that—who knows what kind of disaster this unfeeling creature might unleash.
say:62:1260006036:1.source_cn: 居然这么无所谓地随手把路人变化为亡灵，这种冷酷无情的怪...

say:63:1260006037:1.text: Almost as if in response to Sonja's speculation, a figure rushes in from the street corner.
say:63:1260006037:1.source_cn: 仿佛回答索尼娅的推测一般，一个身影急匆匆地从街口冲了过来。

say:67:1260006038:1.text: The C-Carmine Whispers! Control your men!
say:67:1260006038:1.source_cn: 血、血薇帮的，管管你们弟兄！

say:68:1260006039:1.text: Someone saw the Bear and his gang turning into monsters, too!
say:68:1260006039:1.source_cn: 有人看到“暴熊”他们也变成了怪物！

say:70:1260006041:1.text: We need to stop this chaos from spreading. Let's go.
say:70:1260006041:1.source_cn: 得去制止骚乱继续扩大。我们快走。

say:1:1260007001:0.text: After defeating the monsters, they, just like before, quickly shed their twisted forms and revert to humans.
say:1:1260007001:0.source_cn: 击倒了怪物后，它们果然如前一般，开始迅速褪去扭曲的外表...

say:2:1260007002:0.text: Only this time, the victims seemed unusually energetic.
say:2:1260007002:0.source_cn: 只是，这次的受害者，格外生龙活虎。

say:5:1260007004:1.text: Agh—uh, huh? What happened? Why did I suddenly just...
say:5:1260007004:1.source_cn: 嗷——呃、呃啊？怎么回事？我刚刚怎么突然就……

say:6:1260007005:1.text: Wow, they really did turn back...
say:6:1260007005:1.source_cn: 哇，竟、竟然真的变回来了……

say:7:1260007006:1.text: See, I told you, a good thrashing would fix them, just like when we turned into rats!
say:7:1260007006:1.source_cn: 看，我就说，找人揍他们一顿就能复原，和之前咱们被变成老...

say:10:1260007007:1.text: Ah... I feel like I had a really satisfying dream. Had a big ruckus and taught those Water Wight fools a good lesson—
say:10:1260007007:1.source_cn: 呼……啊。感觉做了个很爽快的梦。大闹了一场，狠狠教训了...

say:14:1260007009:0.text: Ow, ow, ow! Lucca, why did you hit me? I've been behaving and haven't fought at all today.
say:14:1260007009:0.source_cn: 呜哇，疼疼疼！二当家，干嘛突然打我？今天我可老老实实地...

say:17:1260007010:1.text: Who says! You were actual monsters just now, and you attacked us! Even I'm banged up!
say:17:1260007010:1.source_cn: 谁说的！你们刚才是活生生的怪物，见了我们就直接就往脸上...

say:26:1260007013:1.text: ...You all need to clear your heads. I have some questions.
say:26:1260007013:1.source_cn: ……你们都清醒清醒，我有话要问。

say:27:1260007014:1.text: Darlo, before you turned into monsters, did you see a female Graveborn?
say:27:1260007014:1.source_cn: 达里洛，你们在变成怪物之前，有没有见过一个亡灵女性。

say:33:1260007016:0.text: Was she a Graveborn? I'm not sure... At the time, the Bear and the Bobcat were discussing how to deal with the Water Wights. I wanted to greet them...
say:33:1260007016:0.source_cn: 是亡灵吗？我不确定……当时暴熊和山猫大哥在商量怎么找水...

say:34:1260007017:0.text: Just behind them, I spotted a stunning woman—dressed in black with hair as dark as the night!
say:34:1260007017:0.source_cn: 在他们身后不远处，我瞧见一个非常漂亮的妹子——黑衣黑裙...

say:37:1260007018:1.text: Oh? You must work for the top dog around here. I believe I saw you yesterday.
say:37:1260007018:1.source_cn: ………哦？是本地主人的部下吧？昨天似乎看到过你们。

say:38:1260007019:1.text: What a rough bunch... but your energy and enthusiasm are quite fascinating.
say:38:1260007019:1.source_cn: 虽然是些粗野的家伙，但是这份活力和热血倒是颇有趣味……

say:39:1260007020:0.text: Well then, put on a show for me.

say:41:1260007021:0.text: She appeared abruptly before us and said some baffling things, but at that moment, my mind went blank, and I could only stare at her.
say:41:1260007021:0.source_cn: 她非常突兀地出现在我们面前，说了些莫名其妙的话，但，我...

say:42:1260007022:1.text: The two others were also frozen, just staring at her, forgetting what they were supposed to do!
say:42:1260007022:1.source_cn: 当时两位大哥也僵住了，直勾勾地盯着她，都忘记了要干什么！

say:44:1260007023:0.text: Y-yes, in hindsight, her skin and eyes were quite strange... but at the time, I didn't feel anything unusual.
say:44:1260007023:0.source_cn: 是、是啊，明明回想起来，她的肤色和眼睛都很异常……可那...

say:45:1260007024:0.text: I only thought she was extremely beautiful and dignified, even feeling an urge to bow to her...
say:45:1260007024:0.source_cn: 只是觉得非常漂亮，而且很有威严，甚至忍不住想对她行礼……

say:46:1260007025:0.text: I almost did too... but then, I just blacked out.
say:46:1260007025:0.source_cn: 我也差一点就……但紧接着，我就失去意识了。

say:48:1260007026:0.source_cn: ……听起来是她，那个叫瑟西娅的亡灵。

say:49:1260007027:1.text: Unexpectedly, Sonja apologizes to the victims before her—both to the Carmine Whispers and the Water Wights.
say:49:1260007027:1.source_cn: 随即，出乎所有人意料，索尼娅对着眼前的受害者们致歉——...

say:50:1260007028:1.text: Everyone, due to our previous oversight, we were unable to stop her in time.
say:50:1260007028:1.source_cn: 各位兄弟，由于我们此前的疏失，没能及时阻拦她的行动。

say:51:1260007029:1.text: I promise to bolster our forces and strengthen the city's defenses.
say:51:1260007029:1.source_cn: 我们会加派人手，加强城内的守备。

say:54:1260007030:1.text: Uh, ah, no need to be so polite... it's giving me the creeps.
say:54:1260007030:1.source_cn: 呃，啊，不用这么客气吧……搞得背后毛毛的。

say:57:1260007031:1.text: Agreed, while I'd love to see the leader of the Carmine Whispers bowing to me, um, let's just skip ahead.
say:57:1260007031:1.source_cn: 是啊，虽说我是挺想看血薇帮的头头对我毕恭毕敬，但，呃，...

say:58:1260007032:1.text: We were the ones who got ambushed first, and honestly, turning into rats was actually pretty exciting...
say:58:1260007032:1.source_cn: 本来就是我们最先遭了暗算，再说，那时候变成耗子，其实，...

say:61:1260007033:1.text: Just say "it's fine." These lot are too focused on their pride.
say:61:1260007033:1.source_cn: 直接说“没关系”就好了，两位大哥太要面子了……

say:64:1260007034:1.text: The idiots from the Water Wights don't know what's good for them. Just ignore them, boss!
say:64:1260007034:1.source_cn: 水鬼帮的蠢货就是不知好歹，别搭理他们了，当家的！

say:65:1260007035:1.text: Even if we all changed, being Graveborn is still better than being one of those idiots who turned into rats!
say:65:1260007035:1.source_cn: 就算都是变化，我们变成亡灵，也比有些变成耗子的蠢货要强！

say:68:1260007036:1.text: Don't get me wrong, though Graveborns aren't exactly pleasant, the feeling of being one was pretty nice—my whole body felt relaxed and full of energy... like I could keep fighting and taking hits.
say:68:1260007036:1.source_cn: 你别说，虽然亡灵不是什么好东西，但当亡灵的滋味还不错，...

say:71:1260007037:1.text: After all, for some people, their brains are barely functioning to begin with, so becoming a mindless Graveborn just puts them further in their element.
say:71:1260007037:1.source_cn: 毕竟有的人脑子就聊胜于无，变成没有脑子的亡灵之后那不就...

say:73:1260007039:1.text: You can still understand human speech and seem more reasonable now. How about you try turning into a rat? It might make you smarter.
say:73:1260007039:1.source_cn: 还能听得懂人话，看起来更通人性了，你要不要也变个耗子试...

say:74:1260007040:1.text: This is infuriating! I'd rather turn into a Graveborn and teach you a lesson!

say:49:1260011051:1.source_cn: 只要运用得当，就能给人们带来欢笑，但要是使用者别有居心...

say:50:1260011052:1.text: This is part of the essential training for becoming a competent mage.
say:50:1260011052:1.source_cn: 这也是成为合格魔法师必须要修行的课程。

say:51:1260011053:1.text: Yes, because it's Merlin, our minds are at ease.
say:51:1260011053:1.source_cn: 嗯。因为是梅林，我们放心。
say:51:1260011053:1.male: Yes, because it's Merlin, our minds are at ease.
say:51:1260011053:1.female: Yes, because it's Merlin, our minds are at ease.

say:52:1260011054:1.text: To ensure safety, the major transformations will be done when the Fall Harvest officially begins in the evening.
say:52:1260011054:1.source_cn: 稳妥起见，真正的大规模变装，等到晚上秋夜节正式开始举办...

say:55:1260011055:1.text: We'll get the word out to the public about the shapeshifting spell's effects to avoid any panic.
say:55:1260011055:1.source_cn: 我们会加强宣传，让市民提前知道幻形魔法的效用，避免恐慌。

say:56:1260011056:1.text: Hurry and go; I don't want any chaos in Rustport when the Fall Harvest officially kicks off.
say:56:1260011056:1.source_cn: 去吧。要快，秋夜节正式开始时，我不想看到城里大乱。

say:59:1260011058:1.text: Thus, Lucca leads the way, with the Bobcat and Bear, now giddily transformed, used as "demonstrations."
say:59:1260011058:1.source_cn: 于是，卢卡带队，被变成其他样貌的山猫与暴熊也被当做“幻...

say:60:1260011059:1.text: Yet, as Sonja gazes at Rustport, which is beginning to light up by way of the evening lamps, she remains deeply troubled.
say:60:1260011059:1.source_cn: 然而，看着渐渐开始染上夜间灯火的锈锚港，索尼娅仍然眉头紧皱。

say:61:1260011060:1.text: Up to now, everything has been going well. Lucca has spread the news about the Fall Harvest and the shapeshifting spell, and Rustport is still peaceful.
say:61:1260011060:1.source_cn: 目前为止，还算顺利。卢卡已经把秋夜节和幻形活动的消息散...

say:62:1260011061:1.text: I just hope Rustport's first Fall Harvest is a success.
say:62:1260011061:1.source_cn: 希望锈锚港第一个秋夜节，一切顺利。

say:65:1260011062:1.text: Alright, alright, stop looking so grim. Where's the holiday spirit?
say:65:1260011062:1.source_cn: 好了好了，你也别板着脸了，哪还有一点节日的气氛。

say:66:1260011063:1.text: Once we handle Cecia, everything will be just fine.
say:66:1260011063:1.source_cn: 接下来只要解决了那个叫瑟西娅的亡灵，一切就都万事大吉。

say:67:1260011064:1.text: But we still haven't found her. Not only that, but we don't even know the reason why she appeared in Rustport in the first place.
say:67:1260011064:1.source_cn: 但我们仍然没找到她。不仅如此，甚至不知道她突然来锈锚港...

say:70:1260011065:1.text: Reason? When a noble travels, peasants should simply humble themselves and worship without seeking answers.
say:70:1260011065:1.source_cn: 原因？贵族出行，庶民只要谦卑地伏地敬拜就好，不必知道原因。

say:72:1260011067:1.text: Hmph, drawing blades as soon as we meet? Savages will be savages.
say:72:1260011067:1.source_cn: 哼，一见面就要刀剑相向？野蛮人就是野蛮人。

say:73:1260011068:1.text: You just show up out of nowhere; what are you scheming?
say:73:1260011068:1.source_cn: 你突然现身，又在盘算什么？

say:74:1260011069:1.text: Leaving without saying goodbye is very impolite; I figured I owed you a proper farewell.
say:74:1260011069:1.source_cn: 不告而别太过失礼，至少要得到些许欢送。港口的主人。

say:75:1260011070:1.text: You intend to just walk away after all you've done to Rustport?
say:75:1260011070:1.source_cn: 你想一走了之？在对锈锚港那么多人下手之后？

say:76:1260011071:1.text: It should be an honor for commoners to serve as entertainment for royalty.
say:76:1260011071:1.source_cn: 能成为贵族取乐的玩物，是庶民的荣幸。

say:77:1260011072:1.text: Since you refused to fetch the Void Relic for me, the spell's transformation effect wasn't as expected...
say:77:1260011072:1.source_cn: 你们不肯亲自替我把班题斯圣器取来，转换生命形态的魔法效...

say:78:1260011073:1.text: <style="highlight">I must depart for another engagement</style>. This backward cesspool with its poor infrastructure simply isn't worthy of my presence.
say:78:1260011073:1.source_cn: 所以<style=highlight>我要赶往他处赴约...

say:81:1260011074:1.text: She's trying to leave! Stop her!

say:82:1260011075:1.text: Fine, if you're so insistent, I'll comply. It would be rude to refuse again and again!
say:82:1260011075:1.source_cn: 好吧，既然你们如此坚持，再三推脱就有失礼节了！

choice:40:0:1.text: Congrats! Your wish has come true!
choice:40:0:1.male: Congrats! Your wish has come true!
choice:40:0:1.female: Congrats! Your wish has come true!

choice:26:0:1.text: Bear as bear, Bobcat as Glimmerbloom.
choice:26:0:1.source_cn: 暴熊变成熊，山猫变成荧荧花
choice:26:0:1.male: Bear as bear, Bobcat as Glimmerbloom.
choice:26:0:1.female: Bear as bear, Bobcat as Glimmerbloom.

say:84:1260011027:1.text: Following the incantation, a ray of light shines down, and the two people facing each other instantly transform...
say:84:1260011027:1.source_cn: 咒语之后，一道光芒落下，对面的两人顿时变幻了姿态……

say:87:1260011028:0.text: Ah, it's Soren and Alsa, our Mauler comrades from the Ashen Wastes!
say:87:1260011028:0.source_cn: 咦，是索恩和阿尔萨，我们在荒角沙漠结识的蛮血伙伴！

say:88:1260011029:0.text: What's this? Let me take a look. Ah... small frame, but those muscles are pretty solid.
say:88:1260011029:0.source_cn: 什么什么？我看看。喔……身板很小，二头肌倒是还算结实。

say:89:1260011030:0.text: But this face... Hey... Look at my face! My goodness! This is the best I've ever looked!
say:89:1260011030:0.source_cn: 但是这张脸……喂……你们看，我的脸！我的天！这是我出生...

say:90:1260011031:0.text: Suddenly, a scream erupts from beside him.
say:90:1260011031:0.source_cn: 就在这时，他身旁传来一声尖叫。

say:92:1260011032:0.text: What! What's happening? What's wrong with my voice?
say:92:1260011032:0.source_cn: 咦！怎么回事？我的声音是怎么了？

say:93:1260011033:1.text: I... I've turned into a girl...?!

say:95:1260011035:1.text: Of course it's me! What, do I have to kick your butt like usual for you to recognize me?!
say:95:1260011035:1.source_cn: 当然是我！怎么，非得让我像平时那样踢你一脚才认得出来吗？！

say:96:1260011036:1.text: Hahaha! Just wait until the gang hears that the Bobcat turned into a girl!
say:96:1260011036:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈哈哈！你等着，等我回帮里替你好好宣传宣传，山猫变...

say:97:1260011037:0.text: How dare you?! I'll rip off those stupid bear ears before you can blink!
say:97:1260011037:0.source_cn: ——你敢？！我这就把你的熊耳朵撕下来！

choice_prompt:98:1260011037.text: How dare you?! I'll rip off those stupid bear ears before you can blink!
choice_prompt:98:1260011037.source_cn: ——你敢？！我这就把你的熊耳朵撕下来！

say:101:1260011038:0.text: Hey, at least both of you got your wishes granted!
say:101:1260011038:0.source_cn: 至少、至少也算满足你们两方的要求了，嗯！

choice:98:0:1.text: Congrats! Your wish has come true!
choice:98:0:1.male: Congrats! Your wish has come true!
choice:98:0:1.female: Congrats! Your wish has come true!

choice:26:1:2.female: Bear as Soren, Bobcat as Alsa.

say:107:1260011042:0.text: After a moment of exchanging glances, both of them burst into laughter.
say:107:1260011042:0.source_cn: 一阵面面相觑后，两人同时大笑起来。

say:108:1260011043:0.text: Haha! How did you end up like this!
say:108:1260011043:0.source_cn: 哈哈哈哈哈哈，你怎么变成这副德行了！

say:109:1260011044:0.source_cn: 你脸上的面具也好滑稽，哈哈哈哈！

say:110:1260011045:1.text: Alright, today we'll be gruglins! Let's go pillage!
say:110:1260011045:1.source_cn: 好，我们今天就是咕布林！走，抢劫去咯！

say:114:1260011047:1.text: Don't tarnish the good name of the Carmine Whispers; otherwise, you'll answer to me.
say:114:1260011047:1.source_cn: 不许趁幻形期间辱没血薇帮声誉，否则你们知道后果。

choice:26:2:3.text: Both of you, turn into gruglins!
choice:26:2:3.male: Both of you, turn into gruglins!
choice:26:2:3.female: Both of you, turn into gruglins!

choice:13:0:1.text: I can finally unleash my magic!
choice:13:0:1.source_cn: 终于可以尽情使用魔法了
choice:13:0:1.male: I can finally unleash my magic!
choice:13:0:1.female: I can finally unleash my magic!

choice:13:1:2.text: They can't decide what they become!
choice:13:1:2.source_cn: 那要变成什么就由不得他们了！
choice:13:1:2.male: They can't decide what they become!
choice:13:1:2.female: They can't decide what they become!

say:117:1260011011:1.text: Hahaha, what's the problem? Festivals are all about having spontaneous fun, aren't they?
say:117:1260011011:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈哈，有什么不好，过节就是要开开心心的，对吧！

say:118:1260011012:1.text: Don't be so tense; just enjoy the performance from <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:118:1260011012:1.male: Don't be so tense; just enjoy the performance from <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:118:1260011012:1.female: Don't be so tense; just enjoy the performance from <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

choice:13:2:3.text: Well, only I can manage it.
choice:13:2:3.source_cn: 好吧，毕竟只有我能做到
choice:13:2:3.male: Well, only I can manage it.
choice:13:2:3.female: Well, only I can manage it.

narration:1:1260012001:0.text: Despite the crowd's attack, Cecia's grace remains intact. She smiles contemptuously and rises from her throne of thorns.
narration:1:1260012001:0.source_cn: 在众人攻势之下，瑟西娅风度分毫未减，她轻蔑地笑了笑，随...

narration:2:1260012002:0.text: The moment her toes touch the ground, countless thorns erupt from beneath, breaking through the stone tiles and blocking everyone's view.
narration:2:1260012002:0.source_cn: 脚尖点地的瞬间，无数荆棘从地下冲破地面上铺设的石板砖，...

narration:3:1260012003:0.text: Sonja instantly strikes with her sword, but the remaining thorns quickly wither and disappear... and Cecia is nowhere to be seen.
narration:3:1260012003:0.source_cn: 索尼娅当即举剑斩击，但剩下的荆棘迅速枯死、消退……而瑟...

say:6:1260012004:0.text: Tsk. She got away again! And she calls herself a noble? She bolts off faster than I can!
say:6:1260012004:0.source_cn: 啧。还是被她跑了！她也自称贵族？跑得比我都快！

say:8:1260012006:1.text: Given her final words, she likely won't be back.
say:8:1260012006:1.source_cn: 从她最后的话判断，应该不会了。

say:9:1260012007:1.text: No matter how much she belittles and despises Rustport, this place is still our home.
say:9:1260012007:1.source_cn: 不管她如何贬低蔑视锈锚港，这里都是我们寄居的栖身之所。

say:10:1260012008:1.text: This place is worthy of our pride.
say:10:1260012008:1.source_cn: 这座城市值得我们自豪。

say:11:1260012009:1.text: Let's go, the main danger has been dealt with; the Fall Harvest can finally begin.
say:11:1260012009:1.source_cn: 来吧，最大的隐患已经消失，秋夜节随时可以开始了。

narration:13:1260012010:1.text: A moment later, outside Rustport and far away from Sonja and the others...
narration:13:1260012010:1.source_cn: 片刻后，远离索尼娅等人，锈锚港郊外

say:15:1260012011:1.text: You see? Believing you could defeat them alone was pure fantasy.
say:15:1260012011:1.source_cn: 看到了吧，靠你一个人想击败他们，纯属痴心妄想。

say:19:1260012013:0.text: Viperian's research is lacking. Only through the Void Relic can fleshweave spell permanently warp living beings. This falls far short of my goals.
say:19:1260012013:0.source_cn: 维珀里安的研究不过如此。血肉魔法在班题斯圣器驱动下，才...

say:21:1260012015:0.text: Hmph, there's no need for caution. The Void Relic sank into the sea; if you wish to salvage it, go ahead. I prefer not to get my dress dirty with silt.
say:21:1260012015:0.source_cn: 哼，不必警戒。班题斯圣器落于海中，要想去打捞，随你。我...

say:22:1260012016:0.text: Since we are of the same kind, I will assist you in administering a slight punishment to Rustport's inhabitants, but nothing more.
say:22:1260012016:0.source_cn: 看在你我所属同族的份上，我同意帮你为锈锚港的人略施惩戒...

say:23:1260012017:0.text: I'm not interested in senseless slaughter. If you want true revenge, you'll have to do it yourself.
say:23:1260012017:0.source_cn: 我对无谓的屠杀不感兴趣，想要真正的复仇，你得亲自动手。

say:24:1260012018:0.text: And not just the drab residents of Rustport, but Bantus Empire, too...
say:24:1260012018:0.source_cn: 而且，不仅锈锚港那群无聊的生者。班题斯帝国那方……

say:26:1260012020:0.text: The elegant figure conversing with Cecia immediately melts into the shadows, while the one who collided with her is—
say:26:1260012020:0.source_cn: 与瑟西娅对话的窈窕身影瞬间融入了角落的阴影，而迎面撞上...

say:29:1260012021:0.text: Oops, sorry! I didn't mean to!
say:29:1260012021:0.source_cn: 呜哇，抱歉，大姐姐！我不是故意的！

say:30:1260012022:0.text: Hah, how dare you offend me. Are you ready to suffer the consequences, little mortal?
say:30:1260012022:0.source_cn: 呵，居然冒犯我。做好付出代价的准备了吗，小小的生者？

say:31:1260012023:1.text: Wow, your disguise is so beautiful!
say:31:1260012023:1.source_cn: 哇，大姐姐，你的变装好漂亮！

say:32:1260012024:1.text: Happy Fall Harvest! Here's my fish for you! Let's swap!
say:32:1260012024:1.source_cn: 秋夜节快乐！这是我的鱼，送给你！来交换吧！

say:34:1260012026:1.text: Oh, didn't you know? The Carmine Whispers said that tonight we should all prepare fish and exchange them!
say:34:1260012026:1.source_cn: 咦，大姐姐你不知道吗？血薇帮的哥哥姐姐说今天晚上过节，...

say:35:1260012027:1.text: And there are also fantastic costumes... shapeshifting... Basically, everyone will dress up differently from their usual selves! Just like you're doing now!
say:35:1260012027:1.source_cn: 而且还有很厉害很厉害的变装……幻形……总之，大家都会打...

say:36:1260012028:1.text: If you don't have a fish, you can have this one. It's a beautiful rainbow-colored fish I caught from the beach.
say:36:1260012028:1.source_cn: 大姐姐要是没有鱼的话，这条就给你吧，是我从沙滩水坑里捞...

say:37:1260012029:1.text:
...Hmph, foolish country girl.
Here, take this.
say:37:1260012029:1.source_cn: ……哼，无知的乡下丫头。\n拿着这个。

say:39:1260012031:1.text: Hmph, remember, the true Fall Harvest is about exchanging candies with each other.
say:39:1260012031:1.source_cn: 呵，记住，正统的秋夜节就是彼此之间交换糖果。

say:40:1260012032:1.text: I have no need for your tribute. Accept this gift with gratitude.
say:40:1260012032:1.source_cn: 我无需你的供奉。心怀感激地收下这份赐赠吧。

say:41:1260012033:1.text: Oh, thank you! I'll bring candy next year for us to exchange!
say:41:1260012033:1.source_cn: 嗯，谢谢姐姐！明年秋夜节，我也会带上糖跟你交换的！

say:43:1260012034:1.text: The young girl takes the candy Cecia gave her and joyfully departs. Meanwhile, the graceful figure emerges once more from the shadows next to Cecia.
say:43:1260012034:1.source_cn: 小女孩捧着瑟西娅给的糖果，高兴地离开了。与此同时，瑟西...

say:44:1260012035:0.text: Hmph, how naïve. Why would I celebrate Fall Harvest with such a country bumpkin again?
say:44:1260012035:0.source_cn: 呵，真是一厢情愿，我怎么会再和乡下丫头一起过秋夜节呢。

say:46:1260012036:0.text: Yet you gave her a gift.

say:47:1260012037:1.text: Receiving and returning gifts is merely standard etiquette.
say:47:1260012037:1.source_cn: 收礼与回礼，基本礼仪而已。

say:48:1260012038:0.text: I'm leaving. Are you going to stay here, waiting for someone elusive to crawl back from the sea?
say:48:1260012038:0.source_cn: 我要走了。你还要待在这里，等着虚无缥缈的人从海底爬回来？

say:49:1260012039:0.text: He will return. Our fleet will sail once more!
say:49:1260012039:0.source_cn: 他会回来的。我们的舰队终会再次启航！

say:50:1260012040:1.text: This loyalty is admirable. Now, prepare for Bantus Empire. They won't be as lenient as I am and won't allow the Void Relic to go astray.
say:50:1260012040:1.source_cn: 这份忠诚也算是可取。那么，做好迎接班题斯帝国的准备吧。...

say:51:1260012041:1.text: Speaking of which, tonight is the Fall Harvest. The ignorant living are celebrating endlessly.
say:51:1260012041:1.source_cn: 说起来，今天是秋夜节。那些愚蠢的生者正在庆祝个不停呢。

say:52:1260012042:1.text: The Fall Harvest was originally a day for the living to await the dead to return. But the ignorant living have twisted its meaning into something else.
say:52:1260012042:1.source_cn: 秋夜节原本是生者等待着逝者，留在原地的人等待着前往远方...

say:53:1260012043:1.text: Thus, I honor the genuine tradition and hope you can meet again with those you are waiting for.
say:53:1260012043:1.source_cn: 所以，我谨遵真正的传统，祝你能与想等的人再遇吧。

say:1:1260013001:1.text: As the dust settles, Sonja clears her throat at the Sanctum Square in Rustport and addresses the long-awaiting crowd.
say:1:1260013001:1.source_cn: 一切尘埃落定，锈锚港的颂神广场上，索尼娅清了清嗓子，向...

say:3:1260013002:1.text: Good evening to all. I'm not one for long speeches, so I'll keep it short.
say:3:1260013002:1.source_cn: 各位，晚上好。我不擅长长篇大论，所以就简短地致辞。

say:4:1260013003:1.text: We have faced countless crises in the past—battles, deception, poverty, and violence... both external and internal.
say:4:1260013003:1.source_cn: 我们过去曾经经历过无数次的危机，战斗、欺骗、贫穷、暴力...

say:5:1260013004:1.text: That period of suffering and turmoil is likely still vivid in everyone's minds.
say:5:1260013004:1.source_cn: 那段痛苦而混乱的时光，对于大家而言，应该仍然记忆犹新。

say:6:1260013005:1.text: Yet, like cliffs that withstand the endless waves, Rustport, and we ourselves, will never yield.
say:6:1260013005:1.source_cn: 然而，就像永远不会被海浪侵蚀的崖岸一样，锈锚港，以及我...

say:7:1260013006:1.text: Today is the Fall Harvest, a holiday to celebrate and honor fallen heroes!
say:7:1260013006:1.source_cn: 今天是秋夜节，是庆祝丰收，纪念英灵的节日！

say:8:1260013007:1.text: In memory of our departed friends, in celebration of today's peace, and in anticipation of a bright future—
say:8:1260013007:1.source_cn: 为了怀念那些离去的伙伴，为了庆祝今日的安宁，为了迎接将...

say:9:1260013008:1.text:
Let us indulge in joy this night.

say:16:1260013013:1.text: "Nicely" doesn't do it justice! The fireworks are stunning! You've outdone yourself, Hugin!

say:31:1260013021:1.source_cn: 因为这是锈锚港解放后，第一次过节。

say:32:1260013022:1.text: ...You're right. From today, we can say Rustport has reclaimed its own holiday.
say:32:1260013022:1.source_cn: ……你说得对。从今天开始，可以说我们锈锚港重拾了自己的节日。

say:35:1260013023:1.text: That's right! Unlike other places in the Lightbearer Empire, our shapeshifting relies on Merlin's magic, and we trade fish instead of sweets. Plus, there's a spectacular fireworks display!
say:35:1260013023:1.source_cn: 没错，跟耀光别的地方不一样，变装是靠梅林的魔法，交换的...

say:36:1260013024:1.text: This is what makes Rustpoirt truly unique!
say:36:1260013024:1.source_cn: 这正是专属于锈锚港独一无二的特色！

say:39:1260013025:1.text: Heh, when my adventures take me far and wide, the customs of Rustport will surely spread throughout Esperia.
say:39:1260013025:1.source_cn: 哼哼，等将来我的冒险脚步遍及整个大陆，锈锚港的风土人情...

say:40:1260013026:1.text: Then, who knows—people might travel just to enjoy Rustport's special Fall Harvest!
say:40:1260013026:1.source_cn: 到那时，说不定会有人专程来享受锈锚港特色的秋夜节！

say:41:1260013027:1.text: That's something worth looking forward to.
